name: Ancient Red Dragon
senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 28

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.text: If fails save, can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Three attacks: one bite + two claws. Can replace one with fire breath as bonus.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: +17 to hit, reach 15 ft. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 10) piercing + 4 (1d8) fire.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: +17 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (3d6 + 10) slashing.

actions.name: Tail
actions.text: +17 to hit, reach 20 ft. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 10) bludgeoning.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.text: Each creature within 120 ft: WIS save DC 23 or frightened 1 min.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: 90-ft × 10-ft cone: 26 (9d6) fire. DC 24 DEX half or 26 (9d6) ongoing fire.

legendaryActions.name: Wing Attack (Cost 2)
legendaryActions.text: Flies up to half speed; each within 20 ft: 18 (3d6 + 10) bludgeoning. DC 25 STR or prone + pushed 30 ft.
